verdict.rationale: Evidence shows one-line integration across OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, and Vercel AI SDK, implying support for both Python (OpenAI/Anthropic/LangChain) and JS/TS (Vercel AI SDK) ecosystems, and community members confirm quick, one-line onboarding. However, no evidence explicitly names dedicated 'Helicone Python SDK' or 'Helicone JS/TS SDK' packages or documents parity between them. Missing for 10: explicit dedicated SDK package docs for Python and JS/TS, and independent confirmation of feature parity across both languages.
